_comment: ROM library for the web debugger. Every entry is open source; `file` is served from web/roms/ (populated by web/fetch-roms.py, which also verifies `sha256`). Entries with `fixture` are copied from this repository; the rest are downloaded from the author's GitHub release or, when there is none, from a pinned commit of the gbadev Homebrew Hub database (github.com/gbadev-org/games). The entry marked `default: true` is loaded automatically when the debugger opens without a `?rom=` deep link.
